author: New China TV
description: The Boao Forum for Asia (BFA) Annual Conference 2026 held a plenary on Thursday. This year, participants have widely viewed Boao as more than an annual gathering. title: GLOBALink | 25-yr-old Boao forum provides reassuring voice amid global instability, uncertainty

description: Where is the next growth engine? At the 2026 #Boao Forum for Asia in south China's Hainan Province, this question is front and center. From #technology to green growth, new drivers are emerging. With #China's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030) emphasizing innovation and high-quality development, what does this mean for Asia, and for the world?

description:

#SpringinChina #ChinaTravel #naturememes

author: New China TV
description:
Meet Tamas Hajba, a true China expert who has worked in the country since the Boao Forum for Asia was founded 25 years ago. He has witnessed China's transformation firsthand and seen how opening up drives trade and investment.
On China's push to open even wider, he calls the Hainan Free Trade Port a crucial bridge linking the country to global markets.
title: Boao Voice: Opening up has always been an integral part of the Chinese reforms

author: New China TV
description:
Former U.S. Commerce Secretary Carlos Gutierrez has zero concerns about China's economy. He points to a model that has worked for decades, alongside strong fundamentals and a 40-year rise he describes as unprecedented.
At the Boao Forum for Asia Annual Conference 2026--held in a small seaside town in China's island province of Hainan--the self-described "free trade commerce secretary" was equally blunt on tariffs: not what he "would have wanted," and "will have to go away." 
What's grabbing his attention now? China's 15th Five-Year Plan! And he says he's keen to dig into it.
title: Boao Voice: The fundamentals of the Chinese economy are very strong

author: New China TV
description:
A Xinhua correspondent reports from the annual Boao Forum for Asia (BFA) in China's island province of Hainan. Beyond the conference halls, the island offers a glimpse into the future: rooftops covered with solar panels, ground tiles quietly harvesting sunshine, flower-shaped wind turbines spinning silently, and lattes crafted by robot baristas.
At BFA, low-carbon technologies and clever innovations show how a cleaner, more sustainable future is already taking shape.
title: Boao Voice: Living the future in Boao

author: New China TV
description: Researchers at Westlake University in China have unveiled Titan o1, a robot capable of mimicking full-body human movements. Powered by the General Action Expert (GAE) system, it enables coordinated motion without task-specific programming, marking new progress in robotics and human-machine interaction.
title: China's Westlake University Unveils Titan o1 Robot Capable of Mimicking Human Movements
